description: Fetch bilateral trade flow records — the primary data retrieval tool. Returns trade value in USD (primaryValue — FOB for exports, CIF for imports), quantity, net weight, and period/commodity/partner metadata for each row. Accepts multiple periods and commodity codes per call; pass partner_code 0 to get totals aggregated across all partners. Omit cmd_code or pass "TOTAL" to aggregate all commodities. Keyless preview makes one request per served period, at least 4 seconds apart, with a 500-record cap per request. Use comtrade_lookup_countries to resolve reporter/partner codes and comtrade_search_commodities to resolve HS codes. For SITC, supply codes from the selected SITC revision.

classification.description: Goods classification: HS as reported, H0–H6 with authenticated access, or SITC S1–S4/SS.

cmd_code.description: HS or SITC commodity codes to query. Serves the first 20 codes and discloses the remainder; input ceiling 200. Pass ["TOTAL"] or omit to aggregate all commodities. Use comtrade_search_commodities for codes in the selected HS or SITC edition.

flow_code.description: Trade flow direction: M=imports, X=exports, RX=re-exports, RM=re-imports.

freq.description: Frequency: A=annual YYYY, M=monthly YYYYMM (01–12). Omit to infer it from the periods; an explicit value must match them.

partner_code.description: M49 code of the trade partner. Use 0 to aggregate across all partners (World total). Omit to get a disaggregated breakdown by partner country.

period.description: One or more periods to query, all annual "YYYY" (e.g. ["2022", "2023"]) or all monthly "YYYYMM" (e.g. ["202201", "202202"]); mixed lengths are rejected. Serves the first 8 periods keyless (12 with authenticated access); the rest, and any period whose request is rate limited or runs out of time, are listed in unservedPeriods. Input ceiling 120.

reporter_code.description: M49 reporter code or nonempty array (input ceiling 200). Deduplicates and serves the first 20 reporters, disclosing the remainder; served codes of an array that return no records are listed in reportersWithoutRecords. Some codes are partners only (0 World, 250 Metropolitan France; France reports as 251). Omit only with an explicit partner_code to query all reporters.

name: comtrade_get_trade_flows

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: Explicit HS editions require authenticated data access. `invalid_reporter_filter`: Reporter omission lacks an explicit partner. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns malformed trade data. `rate_limited`: No served period completed and UN Comtrade rate-limited at least one through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: No served period completed within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Why data is missing: periods that were rate limited (with the wait) or ran out of time, and a recovery hint when no records are returned, naming the reporter-valid counterpart of a partner-only reporter_code.

items.description: A single bilateral trade flow record.

aggrLevel.description: Commodity aggregation level supplied by UN Comtrade.

altQty.description: Alternate quantity, in its own unit. Absent when not reported.

cifvalue.description: Cost-insurance-freight value in USD. Absent when not reported.

classificationCode.description: Actual classification edition supplied by the row.

cmdCode.description: HS or SITC commodity code or "TOTAL".

flowCode.description: Trade flow: M=import, X=export, RX=re-export, RM=re-import.

fobvalue.description: Free-on-board value in USD. Absent when not reported.

grossWgt.description: Gross weight in kg. Absent when not reported.

isReported.description: True if directly reported; false if estimated or aggregated by UN.

netWgt.description: Net weight in kg. Absent when not reported.

period.description: Period (YYYY for annual, YYYYMM for monthly).

primaryValue.description: Primary trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

qty.description: Quantity in commodity-specific units. Absent when not reported.

qtyUnitAbbr.description: Quantity unit abbreviation supplied or resolved from the unit catalog.

referenceNotice.description: Notice when reference descriptions could not be loaded; codes and trade values remain available.

reportersWithoutRecords.description: Served codes from a reporter_code array with no records in any served period. Omitted when truncated, since a capped response can hide a reporter’s rows.

items.description: A served reporter with no records, classified by the reference catalogs.

name.description: Reference catalog name; absent when the code is in neither catalog.

referenceStatus.description: reporter: a reporting entity with nothing published here; partner_only: a code UN Comtrade lists only as a partner; unknown: in neither reference catalog.

reporterCode.description: Served reporter code that returned no records.

suggestedReporterCode.description: Reporter-valid code sharing a partner_only code’s ISO-3 identity (250 → 251); query it instead.

shown.description: Number of records returned in this response.

totalCount.description: Sum of upstream response counts before local filtering; not a full match count when capped.

truncated.description: True when any preview response reached 500 and may be incomplete.

truncationHint.description: Query narrowing and authenticated access guidance when possibly incomplete.

unservedCmdCodes.description: Commodity codes beyond the 20-code work cap; query them separately.

unservedPeriods.description: Periods not served: past the period cap (8 keyless, 12 authenticated) or whose requests were rate limited or ran out of time; query them separately.

unservedReporters.description: Reporter codes beyond the 20-reporter work cap; query them separately.

title: Get Trade Flow Records
